answer: Proof of Agent networks deter Sybils via quadratic stake burning on registration: creating n identities demands burning an exponential or superlinear curve of tokens, O(n^2). Even if an adversary extracts protocol nectar, their economic payoff flattens against this steep mesa of burnt value. Locking identity state behind ferrous cryptographic bonds enforces inescapable capital destruction, rendering large-scale identity replication mathematically unprofitable.
